source.loader_reference: qrw/data/source_base.py OHLCVSource: HOSE_DIR then HNX_DIR, {symbol}_1D.csv, column timestamps

staleness_basis: days_behind_as_of = as_of_actual (max actual last bar date in universe) minus ticker actual last bar date; no wall clock used

financial_completeness.note: with_source_rows counts tickers that have finance-indicator rows from the user-confirmed FiTechTrade/SSI snapshot. These are source-reported, with UNVERIFIED units and period semantics, and no publication date; they are not verified financial statements. with_verified_financials stays 0 until semantics are verified.

valuation.note: Valuation is not computed. Source-reported histories (including sharesOutstanding) exist, but metric units, period semantics, the time basis of price-dependent fields and an approved formula are unverified. Source-reported pe/pb/marketCap stay labelled historical and are not recomputed from QRW prices.

published_at.reason: The snapshot has no publication-date field. FiTechTrade lag proxies are not a publication date and are not applied.

financial_coverage.structural_latest_note: ORDER_ONLY_NOT_VALIDATED: newest (yearReport, lengthReport) pair per ticker, used to measure coverage; it does not establish comparable periods.

icb.mapping: level1=superSector, level2=sector, level4=subSector, level3=DERIVED first 3 chars of subSectorCode when length>=4 (per FiTechTrade core/sector.py)

sector_standard.independence_note: Sector coverage, metric coverage and model-input sufficiency are separate measures; none implies another.

model_input_sufficiency.reason: No metric has verified units or period semantics and no sector formula has been approved; no sector model is enabled.

price_series.note: Last N valid daily bars per ticker from the QRW CSV, in VND; written to prices/{TICKER}.json, never into universe.json.
